name: Neutral Houses
role: The fourth pole of the Velar political spectrum — houses that have committed to none of the three successor factions
description: Velar houses that are hesitant or opportunistic, watching for leverage or safety rather than committing to the Imperial Loyalists, the Republican Reformists or the Outer Colony Warlords. Characterised in source as "opportunists/hedgers".
political_position: Uncommitted by strategy rather than by weakness: neutrality is leverage while the Imperium’s power balance remains unsettled.
significance: Completes the Velar political spectrum, which canon previously carried as three internal factions. Neutral ground of this kind is what made a neutral Velari world (loc_tkaras_prime) available for Union diplomacy.
